_comment: Non-secret target config. The two base URLs are DELIBERATELY EMPTY: this harness used to default to the production Railway hosts, so a bare `./run.sh smoke` aimed load at production. Set LOADTEST_FRONTEND_URL and LOADTEST_BACKEND_URL, or fill these in for a non-production environment. helpers.js refuses to start against a known production host unless LOADTEST_ALLOW_PRODUCTION=1 is set explicitly.
_pathsComment: Country SLUGS, not codes. /ie/en resolves but is an alias; /ireland/en is what the sitemap and every internal link use, so it is what a load profile should exercise.
